auditor_marcos: Hi team — quick question to start the evidence pack for SOC2: for the auth/API incident on 2025-11-12 we need preserved request logs, CloudTrail entries showing KMS/HSM operations, and a reproducible export. What is our S3 archive TTL for access logs, and what are the exact repro steps to generate the same exported bundle? auditor needs chain-of-custody hashes and a step-by-step playbook.
irina (security): Thanks Marcos. Can you confirm which time range and which services (API gateway, auth service, keystore) you want included? Also are you asking for the KMS key rotation manifest or per-rotation HSM attestations?
auditor_marcos: Range: 2025-11-12 02:00 -> 2025-11-12 06:00 UTC (the window when we saw auth 5xx spikes). Include API gateway logs, token issuance logs from auth service, and keystore KMS calls. We need both rotation manifest (if any) and the HSM operation audit (if applicable). Also need SHA256 of exported tarball.
michael (eng-sre): Ok. Our default S3 lifecycle for access logs is 400 days hot + 3 year archival bucket (glacier) for long-term retention. For the requested window logs are still in hot. We'll produce an export and provide checksum. Quick repro steps below.
michael (eng-sre): repro/playback steps (short):
```
# generate log slice
./infra-tools/s3-slice-export --bucket redwood-logs-access --prefix api/ --start 2025-11-12T02:00:00Z --end 2025-11-12T06:00:00Z --out /tmp/112-export
# include CloudTrail KMS entries
./infra-tools/cloudtrail-export --service kms --start 2025-11-12T01:50:00Z --end 2025-11-12T06:10:00Z --out /tmp/112-cloudtrail
# bundle + checksum
tar -C /tmp -cf /tmp/112-evidence.tar 112-export 112-cloudtrail
sha256sum /tmp/112-evidence.tar > /tmp/112-evidence.tar.sha256
```
michael (eng-sre): We'll run the above and post the S3 presigned for download.
sam (keystore): Note re: KMS: key used for token signing is alias/keystore-prod-sign (arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01-2345). Rotation events are in CloudTrail as KMS:RotateKey, but HSM-level attestations (if customer-managed HSM) are in the HSM audit logs under /var/log/hsm on the appliance and mirrored to s3://keystore-hsm-logs/YYYY/. For our managed HSM we attach the HSM sequence ID to the rotation manifest.
auditor_marcos: Great — for chain-of-custody we need: original S3 object list (object keys + etags), export job commands, who triggered it, and the sha256. Also a short statement about retention policy mapping to control CC6.
irina (security): I'll draft the retention mapping blurb. Michael/Sam, can you confirm who will trigger the export and a target ETA? Ideally we get a signed bundle by EOD Friday.
michael (eng-sre): I'll trigger and attach runbook notes. ETA: starting export in ~20m, complete in ~35-45m (depends on slicing). I'll post the presigned link and sha256.
devops-bot: export-job-5912 started by michael (eng-sre) — slicing s3://redwood-logs-access/api/ 2025-11-12T02:00:00Z -> 2025-11-12T06:00:00Z. Job ID=5912.
michael (eng-sre): devops-bot confirms. I'll capture object manifests with `aws s3api list-objects-v2 --bucket redwood-logs-access --prefix api/ --query 'Contents[?LastModified>=`2025-11-12T02:00:00Z` && LastModified<=`2025-11-12T06:00:00Z`].[Key,ETag]'` and attach as manifest.json.
sam (keystore): For rotation manifest we'll include: rotation_id, key_arn, previous_key_id (if any), rotated_by (service account), HSM_sequence_id, and KMS CloudTrail event IDs. I'll export those to /tmp/rotation-manifest.json and include in bundle.
auditor_marcos: Perfect. Also include the log integrity steps you perform (re-hash per-object before tar) — auditor will want the per-object sha256 list.
michael (eng-sre): Will do per-object sha256s and include verification script. Example snippet:
```
find /tmp/112-export -type f -print0 | xargs -0 sha256sum > /tmp/112-perfile.sha256
```
michael (eng-sre): devops-bot: update when upload complete.
devops-bot: export-job-5912 completed — bundled /tmp/112-evidence.tar uploaded to s3://redwood-evidence-exports/2103456789-112-evidence.tar. Presigned URL valid 72h: https://presigned.example/2103456789-112-evidence.tar
michael (eng-sre): Uploaded and sha256 (hex): 3b2f9a8c1d...f4c (I'll paste full hash in the artifact). Link posted in thread.
irina (security): I'll prepare the control mapping doc (CC6 retention + CC7 chain of custody) and add signatures: evidence owner = michael (eng-sre), reviewer = irina (security). ETA for combined package: 2 hours.
auditor_marcos: Thanks everyone — this looks good. Once I download I'll verify hashes and replay a subset using the provided script. Please keep the raw manifests and CloudTrail JSON intact (no redaction) for auditor verification. :thumbsup:
